translations.web: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.
translations.bsb: Then the Israelites traveled on and camped in the plains of Moab near the Jordan, across from Jericho.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.
translations.asv: And the children of Israel journeyed, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.
